verification_status: ANALYZED; sealed evidence checked, experiments not rerun
comparison_scope: Separate cohorts only. Same condition n=3 each; no pooling, no cross-warmup pairing, no causal variance-reduction claim
verdict_scope: GATE11_LIMITED_PILOT_POLICY_REVIEW/0.1; policy inputs ready for separate Gate12 review, not Protocol Freeze or Formal
verdict_basis: Actual common-w3 paired contract and all required semantic checks passed; finite repeat/quality/perturbation policy chosen with explicit claim contraction, not n=3 precision or stability assurance

policy_recommendations.warmup_scope: Each fresh process uses three same-contract warmups before successful drain; N1 measured stream remains fresh
policy_recommendations.warmup_claim: Bounded conditioning, not complete convergence, stationary or unbiased latency guarantee

repeat.schedule: Original three whole-block schedules plus their mirrored condition and paired-pass orders
repeat.rationale: Balanced order and bounded cost for a limited descriptive comparison; not power, CI coverage or proof n=6 is sufficient

statistics.unit: Whole matched condition/pass block for resampling; one measured request per process
statistics.performance_primary: Pass0 full_request; phases and contrasts reported together
statistics.analysis: All raw block values, mean/median/range/SD; joint whole-block percentile bootstrap and leave-one-block-out sensitivity
statistics.b: Per qualified sync, preserve origin/W/terminal; never add across sync or treat syncs as independent repeats

precision.interpretation: Report achieved intervals and sensitivity; limit claims when uncertain, do not declare equivalence/stable benefit, drop valid samples or add runs until significant

perturbation.pair_delta: Signed total observation/run/order difference, not pure Nsight cost

quality.hard_checks: Identity/input/token/config/clock/completion/drain/ownership/necessary dependencies/terminal/diagnostic and exact integer conservation unchanged
quality.missing_or_conflict: Reject affected window/claim and stop batch when required evidence is missing or impact is unbounded
quality.bounded_local_gap: Keep unattributed and reason; publish supported part or conservative bounds, not Host/residual filling
quality.supported_b_valid: Physical-call count/clipped-duration diagnostics, not request exposure percentage
quality.numeric_rules: No zero-unattributed requirement, no retrospective overhead% cutoff, no arbitrary clock tolerance
quality.marker: Retain delay/duration, no lag correction or sub-ms cross-clock precision claim
quality.allocation: Opaque cudaMalloc remains non-submit resource API cost, internal wait not decomposed, unknown size retained

retained: Qualified N1 per-sync B and prescribed contrast with uncertainty
Finite-workload information-gain question assessed after future frozen collection, may yield inconclusive/no gain
prohibited: Fine stable end-to-end speedup or performance ranking
Pure Nsight/marker/wait causal cost or precise profiled-to-unprofiled attribution transfer
Natural-default-stream full physical B or hidden progress
Whole-request hidden time by adding B, decomposed allocation wait, hardware causes or general performance prediction
Information gain, Formal eligibility or statistically guaranteed precision from Pilot

ready: Same-policy warmup3 applicability across both passes, with finite-conditioning limits
Recommended fixed six balanced blocks and repeat1; whole-block analysis and bounded cost
All valid samples/negative deltas, failure/partial/no-retry handling
Hard semantic and bounded-gap policies, perturbation reporting and claim contraction
precision_not_promised: 10ms Request/Prefill and 5ms Decode are candidates, not demonstrated guarantees
No claim of complete warmup convergence, independent stationary process population, stable N1 benefit
gate12_remaining: User confirmation of the proposed finite policy and contracted claims
Bind final execution/analyzer/registry/schema/statistical implementation and protocol version/signature
Formal budget and execution authorization only after freeze; no server operation from this report
